results.text:
# Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters! · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters!

The family-run business has officially opened the doors to its new 90,000 sq. ft. facility at 3100 Mainway, marking the largest investment in the company's history and a significant milestone in its continued growth.

From humble beginnings as a one-room operation in a Mississauga home to a 16,000 sq. ft. location on Harvester Road in 2017, Kwiksave Logistics has grown into a trusted final-mile logistics provider, distributing orders across the Greater Toronto Area.

Founded by Matthew and Maryam Sabet and now led by their children, Shariar, Rameen and Parisima, the company continues to build on a strong family legacy. During the ribbon cutting, the family reflected on their gratitude to their parents for laying the foundation for the business and shared their excitement for the opportunities Burlington offers as they continue to grow.

We're proud to celebrate this milestone and look forward to seeing Kwiksave Logistics continue to thrive in Burlington.

# Camco Chemical Announces 130,000-Square-Foot Northern Kentucky Distribution Expansion

 Published on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 by Nicole Shakir, Managing Editor of Expansion Solutions Magazine 

### New Independence facility will expand fulfillment, warehousing and supply chain capacity for the family-owned manufacturer

INDEPENDENCE, Ky. (September 2, 2026) — RSA Properties LLC and Camco Chemical have announced plans to construct a new 130,000-square-foot warehouse and distribution center on Camco Chemical’s existing Holton Drive campus in Independence, Kentucky.

The new facility will expand Camco’s fulfillment and distribution capacity while strengthening its broader supply chain capabilities and supporting continued growth across its contract manufacturing operations in Northern Kentucky.

RSA Properties, the family-owned real estate entity developing the project, will work with Furlong Building as contractor. Once complete, Camco Chemical will integrate the facility into its existing operations.

# Milo’s Tea Expands Manufacturing and Cold Chain Infrastructure in Alabama

By Prakash Mishra July 17, 2026 4 Mins Read

Milo’s Tea Company, Inc., the family-owned and certified women-owned business behind America’s number 1 selling refrigerated tea, today announced the expansion of its operational footprint in Birmingham, Ala., with the addition of a 150,000-square-foot refrigerated distribution centre off Lakeshore Parkway, strategically located near its Bessemer manufacturing operation.

The facility employs about 50 associates, creating quality jobs in the region and continuing Milo’s legacy of investing in the communities it serves.

The opening marks the fourth major facility investment Milo’s has made since 2020, a pace that is nearly unheard of for a third-generation family business, bringing the company’s total domestic manufacturing investment over that period to almost $400 million.
